suites.title: Test File Reorganization (V6_6 extracted from V5_60)

finalModel: R~1 is BOTH a DSVC attractor and efficiency law. 44% of random DSVC systems naturally achieve R>0.95. |R-1| decreases with 1/N (R_inf=0.997). DSVC theorem (|r|>0.9 => R>0.95) holds at 100% compliance. Causal chain: R~1 -> Conservation -> Compression -> Geometry -> Function. Variance cancellation is the primitive.
supportedClaims: R~1 is a DSVC universality law (not SAC-specific)
R~1 is both an attractor and maximum-efficiency point
Random DSVC ensembles: 44% achieve R>0.95 without tuning
|R-1| ~ 0.003 + 0.037/N -> R converges to 1 as N grows
Conservation is the PRIMARY consequence of R~1
Causal chain: R~1 -> Conservation -> Compression -> Geometry -> Function
Variance cancellation is the primitive; all else is downstream
Conservation, compression, and geometry are separable (counterfactuals)
R acts as a control parameter: var(I1)/var_terms = (1-R) exactly
hypotheses: DSVC may define a new universality class beyond the tested families
R~1 may be derivable as a maximum-entropy principle
